items.statement: Over 12 months, the pathway will reduce the proportion of dental pain consultations with an antibiotic prescription from about 58 percent to 38 percent or less, compared with usual care.
items.rationale: The retrieved trial reached a similar level; the triage line addresses the main reason GPs prescribe.
items.risks: Few practices; the triage line may be under-used.

items.statement: The pathway will not increase emergency attendance or admission for dental infection within 14 days.
items.rationale: No signal of harm in the retrieved trial; rare events.
items.risks: Too few events to exclude a small increase.

items.statement: The reduction in prescribing will be at least as large in the most deprived practices.
items.rationale: The triage line targets lack of dental access, which is greatest there.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 primary, h2 safety, h3 equity.
